title: Specified cohomology-to-stalk class map
statement: Let f:X→Y be a scheme morphism, y∈Y, F an O_X-module, p≥0, A=O_{Y,y}, c:Spec A→Y, X′=Spec A×_Y X, f′ the first projection, g′ the second projection, and F′=g′*F. Let C=H^p(X′,F′) with A-scalars through Gamma-Spec followed by f′.appTop, and S=(c_*R^p f′_*F′)_y. Define the additive map b:C→S by using the specified Mathlib injective resolution K of F′: identify Gamma(X′,K) termwise with the top sections of f′_*K, apply resolutionSectionClass K (f′_*K) top id p, then the inverse right-derived resolution comparison on top, then the germ at y in c_*R^p f′_*F′. This uses the constructions of [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices] and [def-pc-module-stalk-functor].

source.place: Lemma 20.7.3 (Tag 01E4), the cocycle/sheafified cohomology comparison, and Lemma 30.20.7 (Tag 02OD), the local spectrum computation before formal functions.

proof.text: Compose resolutionSectionClass, isoRightDerivedObj.inv on top, and the top germ. The section-complex comparison is the identity, since inverse image of top is definitionally top. The composite is a specified additive morphism, not an unspecified witness.

def localDirectImage_stalk_class {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (y : Y)
    (F : X.Modules) (p : ℕ) :
    (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (pullback (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f).toRingedSpace p ⋙
        ModuleCat.restrictScalars
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Y.presheaf.stalk y))).inv ≫
            (pullback.fst (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f).appTop).hom).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F) →+
    (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Y.toRingedSpace y).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Y.fromSpecStalk y)).obj
        (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.fst (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).rightDerived
          p).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F)))
